setup: if [ -f "$SUPERSET_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" ]; then cp "$SUPERSET_ROOT_PATH/.env.local" .env.local; echo "env: copied .env.local from $SUPERSET_ROOT_PATH"; else echo "env: MISSING $SUPERSET_ROOT_PATH/.env.local - see CLAUDE.md > Environment"; exit 1; fi

npm ci --no-audit --fund=false; if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/next ]; then echo "deps: install left node_modules/.bin empty - reinstalling from scratch"; rm -rf node_modules; npm ci --no-audit --fund=false; fi; if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/next ]; then echo "deps: FAILED - node_modules/.bin is still empty. Run by hand: rm -rf node_modules && npm ci"; exit 1; fi; echo "deps: ok ($(ls node_modules/.bin | wc -l | tr -d ' ') binaries linked)"
